title: Model common magic item combat bonuses and defensive effects
description:
Scope:
- Cover common deterministic magic item effects: AC bonuses, weapon bonuses, saving throw DCs, damage, resistance/immunity, advantage/disadvantage, conditions, spell grants, and activation requirements.
- Include magic-item:armor-of-invulnerability as an explicit example from Codex.

Acceptance criteria:
- Inventory magic items with numeric combat/defense effects.
- Add typed projections for bounded categories.
- Tests cover armor, weapon, resistance/immunity, spell-granting, and save/DC examples.
notes:
Exact worklist now exists (2026-07-06): the C2 tags in the 18.7.7.3 inventory artifact (PR #407) — 169 of 240 items carry C2 clauses. Scope per artifact §1: rarity-scaled bonuses, type-scoped riders, crit riders/thresholds, save-DC'd effects, resistance/immunity/vulnerability, adv/dis grants, spell-grant projections, activation requirements. The effects vocabulary defined here is reused wholesale by M1 consumable payloads and M2/M3 passives (PR #408 contract §3). Split-owner rule applies (armor-of-invulnerability: C2 effects + C1 1/dawn).
PR #408 final contract (7090d6c): effects vocabulary plus operation→effect binding (operations[].effects references effect ids). Per-item clause-registry rows for C2 clauses land with this bead; bindings must resolve to concrete effect ids, not block presence.
2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: Combat/defense bonuses should close as typed pack effects with operation bindings and F-family hook/disposition evidence for application. Derived-math, roll resolution, resistance/vulnerability transforms, and special modifier application are shared engine concerns; the pack must expose the data and hook requirement without reimplementing those services privately.
Implemented the source-grounded family projector, strict schema validation, clause registry bindings, generated pack projection, and representative/exhaustive tests. The exact 240-row owner-tag conservation census passes; all magic items now carry reviewed executable mechanics.
close_reason: Source-faithful executable magic-item family complete; canonical regeneration, conservation gates, deep audit, and full worktree verification pass.
